newsitem.title: CANADA: Magna to acquire Tricom for C$72 million ($52 million).
newsitem.headline: Magna to acquire Tricom for C$72 million ($52 million).

text.p: Magna International Inc. said Monday it entered an agreement to acquire Britain's Tricom Group Holdings Ltd., a maker of seats, seating frames and other seat components for the car industry, for C$72 million ($52 million).
Tricom, whose customers include Ford Motor Co. and General Motors Corp., has three plants in Britain.

Markham, Ontario-based Magna said the latest acquisition is part of its strategy to become a leading supplier of seating systems to the global automotive industry. The deal is expected to be completed by May 23.
